topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, course welcome, and learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss non-targeted modalities including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapeutic agents along with their mechanisms of toxicity and drug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting cancer cell vulnerabilities and synthetic lethality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that target intrinsic cancer cell vulnerabilities, including hormone dependency, checkpoint deficiencies, and DNA repair defects.

topics.label: Kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine oncogenic kinase signaling, small-molecule kinase inhibitors, and the molecular mechanisms underlying resistance and bypass pathways.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on the design and therapeutic applications of targeted monoclonal antibodies and cytotoxic antibody-drug conjugates.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and T-cell-directed therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the principles of immune surveillance and modern immunotherapies designed to harness and direct T-cell responses against tumors.

topics.label: Perspectives, challenges, and future directions in cancer management
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate broad historical progress, persistent clinical challenges, prevention strategies, and emerging paradigms in cancer care.
